items.question: What does Bhaṇḍa say while smiling before beginning as the demon?
premises: He asks someone to listen to something.
items.inference: Bhaṇḍa opens his reply with a smiling address before taking up the demon role.
uncertainties: The exact addressee and the content of kiñcit are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Bhaṇḍa spoke, smiling: 'Listen to something,' and began as the demon.
